name: rootlco-platform
description: RootLco — Root Link Company. Commercial Multi-Tenant Automotive CRM and ERP Platform. The product name is configured in apps/web/src/config/brand.ts and apps/api/src/shared/constants/app.ts, which scripts/ci/check-product-name-authority.mjs holds identical; the current working name is temporary. Confidential and proprietary.

scripts.dev:down: npm run supabase:stop && docker compose down
scripts.dev:reset: npm run supabase:stop && docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build && npm run supabase:start && npm run supabase:reset
scripts.dev:up: docker compose up -d --build && npm run supabase:start
scripts.format:check:all: npm run format:check && npm run format:check:api && npm run format:check:web
scripts.gate:p1-13: npm run validate:module-boundaries && npm run validate:authorization-coverage && npm run validate:openapi && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run security:all && npm run test && npm run test:backend
scripts.security:all: npm run security:tracked-secrets && npm run security:browser-secrets && npm run security:scope-exclusions && npm run validate:no-fake-data
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run style:check && npm run security:browser-secrets && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify:api: npm run typecheck:api && npm run lint:api && npm run format:check:api && npm run build:api
scripts.verify:classifications: npm run validate:crm-classification && npm run validate:veh-classification && npm run validate:aptrec-classification && npm run validate:wo-tech-dia-qms-classification && npm run validate:svc-quo-inv-classification && npm run validate:sal-wty-rpt-classification
scripts.verify:contracts: npm run validate:module-boundaries && npm run validate:authorization-coverage && npm run validate:operation-coverage && npm run validate:openapi && npm run validate:exact-money && npm run validate:p1-24-register
scripts.verify:inventories: npm run validate:p1-19-inventory && npm run validate:p1-20-inventory && npm run validate:p1-21-inventory && npm run validate:p1-22-inventory && npm run validate:p1-23-inventory
scripts.verify:policies: npm run validate:encoding && npm run validate:run-block-syntax && npm run validate:command-coverage && npm run validate:web-topology && npm run validate:api-backend-only && npm run validate:generated-artifacts && npm run validate:product-name && npm run validate:p1-26-frontend
scripts.verify:repository: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:unit && npm run security:all
scripts.verify:web: npm run typecheck:web && npm run lint:web && npm run style:check:web && npm run format:check:web && npm run test:web && npm run validate:web-tokens && npm run validate:web-brand && npm run validate:web-boundary && npm run build:web && npm run test:web-e2e
scripts.verify:workspaces: npm run verify:policies && npm run verify:repository && npm run verify:api && npm run verify:web && npm run verify:contracts && npm run verify:inventories && npm run format:check:all

comment:overrides: Security overrides. Each entry forces a PATCHED version of a transitive dependency whose direct parent still pins a vulnerable range, so `npm audit` reports zero HIGH/CRITICAL rather than a permanently ignored baseline. Remove an entry only when the parent's own pin has caught up. See docs/engineering/ci-automation/security-model.md.
